applies_when: The product or its immediate shelf area occupies a visually prominent position and has visible space for shopper-facing communication
check: Is there graphical or brand messaging near the product beyond the product packaging itself?
suggestion: Add prominent graphical messaging to reinforce brand presence at a highly visible point in the shopping experience

applies_when: Product is shelved without raised signage and visible vertical space could support additional communication
check: Would a riser provide useful additional brand or product messaging above the current presentation?
suggestion: Consider adding a riser to increase messaging height and visual separation from surrounding merchandise

applies_when: A PDQ or standalone display case is present, or visible product communication indicates a launch, limited-time item, or line extension
check: Does the presentation use dedicated display space to highlight the launch, limited-time item, or product extension?
suggestion: Use PDQ or dedicated display space to spotlight launches or line extensions and create a stronger product destination

applies_when: Product packaging shape appears physically stackable, such as boxes, cartons, cans, tubs, or similarly stable packages
check: Is the product arranged to take advantage of its visible stackability?
suggestion: Reconfigure into a stacked presentation when the visible package geometry and available space support it

applies_when: The selected product is visibly adjacent to another product category and their relationship is supported by packaging, signage, provided context, or an obvious shared use case
check: Could a PDQ, tray, shelf-edge element, or other display bridge the adjacent product categories more intentionally?
suggestion: Use a PDQ, tray, or shelf-edge communication to create a clearer cross-merchandising connection where the visible context supports it

applies_when: Multiple visible brand, product, or promotional communication elements are present around the selected product
check: Do the visible messaging elements work together visually and communicate a clear, consistent product or brand story?
suggestion: Align visible messaging, graphics, and benefit callouts so the presentation reads as one cohesive branded experience

applies_when: Packaging, signage, a display, or another shopper-facing communication surface is visible
check: Is there a visible QR code or digital element that could connect the physical shopping experience to additional product information?
suggestion: Consider adding a QR code or other digital bridge where additional product information, education, or online content would benefit the shopper

applies_when: Visible shelf or pegboard space exists around the selected product
check: Is the visible merchandising space being used effectively without meaningful gaps, weak facings, or unused allocation?
suggestion: Adjust product quantity, facings, placement, or display footprint to make stronger use of the available merchandising space

applies_when: A sample, tester, trial-size, demonstration, or similar sampling presentation is visibly present
check: Does the sample or trial presentation include a clear branded header or communication element?
suggestion: Add or strengthen branded header messaging to connect the sampling experience to the product and brand

applies_when: The selected product has visible shelf-edge area directly below or adjacent to it
check: Is the shelf edge being used to communicate branding, benefits, product differentiation, or promotional information?
suggestion: Use shelf-edge signage, strips, blades, or callouts to add communication without requiring a larger display footprint
visual_signals: product directly above usable shelf edge

applies_when: A fixture or product grouping has visible space above it that could support a header or topper
check: Could a header or topper create a clearer branded destination or improve product communication?
suggestion: Add or strengthen a header or topper when visible space and fixture structure support additional communication

applies_when: A display, rack, fixture, or dedicated merchandising structure has a clearly visible side surface
check: Is the visible side surface being used effectively for shopper-facing brand or product communication?
suggestion: Use available side-panel space for branding, product benefits, education, or supporting visual communication

applies_when: Visible unused vertical space exists above the selected product or merchandising area
check: Could the unused vertical space support more product, stacking, signage, a riser, header, or another merchandising structure?
suggestion: Use available vertical space for additional product presentation or branded communication when physically supported by the scene

applies_when: The selected product is merchandised on a standard shelf, pegboard, floor area, or other non-dedicated presentation and visible evidence suggests a dedicated structure could improve its presence
check: Would a dedicated merchandising structure create stronger product organization, visibility, capacity, or branded communication?
suggestion: Consider an appropriately scaled dedicated display such as a PDQ, rack, sidekick, sidecap, endcap, floorstand, half-pallet, or full-pallet when the visible product volume, package form, and retail environment support it

applies_when: A sidekick, sidecap, endcap, floorstand, pallet display, rack, or similarly substantial dedicated display structure is visible
check: Are the available front, side, header, and structural surfaces being used effectively for product presentation and communication?
suggestion: Use available display surfaces more intentionally for coordinated branding, messaging, navigation, and product presentation

applies_when: A dedicated display fixture has visible capacity for product or merchandising components
check: Is the available display capacity being used effectively without appearing meaningfully underfilled or poorly organized?
suggestion: Adjust product quantity, facings, shelf configuration, or display layout to better use the available fixture capacity

applies_when: A sidekick, sidecap, endcap, floorstand, pallet display, or other secondary merchandising placement is present
check: Does the secondary display create a distinct visual destination that is clearly differentiated from the surrounding primary shelf environment?
suggestion: Strengthen the secondary display through clearer visual hierarchy, dedicated messaging, stronger product organization, or more intentional use of the fixture

applies_when: Part of the selected product, package face, branding, or product communication is visibly blocked or difficult to see
check: Is the primary product face or communication obscured by adjacent products, shelf hardware, signage, fixture components, or poor placement?
suggestion: Adjust placement, facing, fixture structure, or surrounding components so the primary product face and communication remain visible

applies_when: Multiple units or facings of the selected product are visible
check: Are the visible units faced, aligned, and organized in a way that creates a clear and intentional product presentation?
suggestion: Improve facing alignment, product orientation, or grouping to create a cleaner and more deliberate presentation

applies_when: The selected product visually blends into surrounding merchandise or lacks a clear visual boundary from adjacent products
check: Would additional structure, spacing, signage, color, or branded communication help the selected product read as a more distinct destination?
suggestion: Create stronger visual separation using an appropriate combination of signage, spacing, fixture structure, branded graphics, or dedicated merchandising
visual_signals: selected product blends with neighboring products
